shared_elements: tall vertical rectangular panel/pillar entirely covered in low relief
horizontal band of repeated geometric pattern (zigzag/chevron / net)
row of repeated arc or crescent shapes
schematic figures rendered in flat raised relief with outlined contours
stacked registers of motifs down the shaft
limbs/arms rendered as narrow flat bands with splayed digits
justification: Both are tall relief-covered vertical slabs organised into stacked registers, with a horizontal zigzag/net band and a row of repeated arc-or-crescent shapes rendered in flat, schematic, outlined low relief, which gives a comparable overall impression. But the depicted subjects diverge almost entirely: A centres on a single frontal anthropomorph with a rayed, mask-like head, arms and legs and flanking crescents, while B shows profile quadrupeds and several birds distributed under an arcade, with no human figure and no radiating head.
